tagline: 8-voice subtractive synth with filter, effects and four patches
description: An 8-voice subtractive synthesizer: one oscillator (sine, saw or square), an ADSR amp envelope, and a multi-mode filter per voice, followed by saturation, chorus and reverb. It comes with Init, Bass, Pad and Lead patches, offered to the host as programs.

features.name: Oscillator
features.description: Sine, sawtooth or square, with note velocity setting the level

features.name: ADSR envelope
features.description: Attack and decay 1 ms to 2 s, release 1 ms to 5 s, sustain 0 to 1; linear segments

features.name: Multi-mode filter
features.description: Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or notch state-variable filter; cutoff 20 Hz to 20 kHz, resonance (Q) 0.5 to 10

features.name: Effects
features.description: Saturation (soft clip, hard clip or tube) into a stereo chorus into a Schroeder-style reverb, each with its own mix

features.name: Factory patches
features.description: Init, Bass, Pad and Lead, chosen from a menu or from the host's program list

features.name: 8-voice polyphony
features.description: Round-robin voice stealing when a ninth note arrives

useCases: Bass - start from the Bass patch: dark low-pass, short release, a little tube drive
Pads - start from the Pad patch: slow attack and release, chorus and a large room
Leads - start from the Lead patch: square wave with chorus and some reverb
Learning synthesis - change one control at a time and listen
learningFocus: Polyphonic voice management and voice stealing
A serial effects chain (saturation, chorus, reverb)
Factory patches exposed as host programs

algorithms.name: ADSR Envelope
algorithms.description: Linear attack to 1.0, linear decay to the sustain level, linear release from wherever the note was released

algorithms.name: Voice Stealing
algorithms.description: Round-robin voice allocation when all 8 voices are active
